notice.message_id: zero for STOP without an active turn; otherwise accepted DATA id

host_rules: supervisor priority CONTROL queue independent of bounded DATA mailbox
STOP fences new DATA and drains all previously accepted queued and in-flight work
PANIC fences new DATA and continuation resumption, settles current DATA as FAILED, pending queued DATA as ABANDONED
at most one PANIC supervisor notice for each actor generation; duplicate STOP coalesces, STOP-to-PANIC escalation retained
a YIELD retains one accepted in-flight DATA turn and may not increment completed or re-admit
workers must physically quiesce before frame reclamation or actor reincarnation
stale actor generation and stale message sequence cannot send, complete or resume
accepted = completed + failed + abandoned + queued + in_flight for every actor generation
host must preserve guest fault code after trap and deliver supervisor PANIC independently of DATA capacity
limits_nonclaims: No forced OS-thread preemption or proof of hard-real-time deadlines; one dedicated worker per actor is not a pooled scheduler
